The vellak has an unfamiliar head (an elongated, narrow, beak-like or plated muzzle with no camel lips), a neck and limb joints of non-mammalian proportion, splayed multi-toed or hooked strider feet, and a patterned alien hide, so that without the sail it would still not read as a camel.
